topic: How to choose between 3L and 5L Pressure Cooker
content: A 3-Litre pressure cooker is ideal for small families of 2 to 3 members or daily side dishes. A 5-Litre pressure cooker is recommended for families of 4 to 6 members or cooking main rice dishes.
Appachatty features curved sides ideal for Kerala appam, unniyappam, and traditional curries with minimal oil. Frypans offer flat wide surfaces ideal for sautéing, omelettes, and shallow frying.
